messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Control-plane: spike in 5xx from downstream dependencies (auth/org-lookup/config). Error rate 5xx > 6% for last 3m, user-facing timeouts observed. Auto-pager triggered. Root TS 2067894321
Mia Chen: oncall here, looking now. which routes are impacted?
Ashwin Patel: seeing elevated 502/504 from gateway -> auth-service and org-lookup. traces show timeouts at auth-token-fetch and org-cache misses.
Mia Chen: ok tagging infra and platform. @Sara can you check config-store metrics?
Sara Gomez: config-store RTT spiked 2.1s -> 6.8s and read errors starting ~2067894280. throwing 500s at control-plane.
Kevin O'Neil: billing svc also surfaced some 5xx for token validation calls, looks correlated to auth latency.
Mia Chen: impact: control-plane APIs returning 5xx causing client SDK retries and elevated latencies. external customers may see failed prompts / 502s.
Ashwin Patel: quick mitigation idea: enable auth token cache fallback (serve cached tokens for 30s) and bump circuit-breaker to fail-open for non-auth-critical routes. can we apply a canary?
Mia Chen: do it. Ashwin you have perms? If not, I'll run the play.
Ashwin Patel: I can toggle via console. preparing command.
OpsBot: Deploy request queued by Ashwin Patel. Change: auth.token_cache.fallback=enabled (30s), cb.failopen.threshold=0.3 for org-lookup-service.
Ashwin Patel: applied to 10% of control-plane nodes (canary). config commit id: cfg-2026-03-15-ashwin-01
Mia Chen: watching metrics. canary looks good so far: auth latency down ~40% on canary nodes, 5xx rate reduced in that cohort.
Sara Gomez: config-store team: we can enable read-retry with backoff + local in-memory TTL increase to reduce load. pushing patch now.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Canary change healthy at 10%. Observed 5xx drop from 6.3% -> 2.1% on canary nodes within 90s.
Kevin O'Neil: start customer impact tally: internal product metrics show ~12% of API keys experienced at least one error in window 2067894200-2067894360. No major billing anomalies yet.
Mia Chen: good. Next steps: 1) extend fallback to 100% across control-plane (rollback path ready), 2) apply config-store backoff/ttl patch, 3) monitor for regression and escalate to infra if storage errors continue.
Ashwin Patel: expanding fallback to 100% now. applying change id cfg-2026-03-15-ashwin-02
OpsBot: Change applied to 100% of nodes.
Mia Chen: metrics: global 5xx dropped to 1.5% and percentiles back to baseline. customer-facing errors should be mitigated.
Sara Gomez: config-store patch rolled to 50% of replicas; read latency improving, error rate falling.
Kevin O'Neil: drafting status update for SRE and support: short blurb with impact and mitigation.
Mia Chen: quick incident summary for status page: "Short-lived control-plane elevated 5xx due to cascading timeouts in config-store and auth; mitigation applied (token-cache fallback, circuit-breaker adjustments, config-store retries) and error rates are returning to baseline. Investigating root cause and will follow up with postmortem." Any objections?
Ashwin Patel: fine from infra side. Will prepare logs and traces export for postmortem.
Sara Gomez: adding heap / GC and network metrics for config-store; suspicious spike in read amplification.
IncidentBot: :pager: Pager acknowledgment recorded: responder Mia Chen, started 2067894323.
Mia Chen: handing off to next oncall for night window: @Kevin you take the remainder and runbook items? I'll be reachable for escalation.
Kevin O'Neil: taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring for 2h; filling in incident doc and setting follow-ups.
Mia Chen: thanks — action items in ticket: 1) collect logs/traces (Ashwin), 2) postmortem draft (Kevin), 3) root cause analysis for config-store read amplification (Sara).
Kevin O'Neil: acknowledged. moving to follow-up channel and will update the incident ticket with timeline + mitigation details.
Mia Chen: closing on-call thread — we'll keep incident open for postmortem. good job team :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident thread closed for on-call handoff at 2067894399."
